notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Based on your feedback throughout Steam Next Fest thus far, we have applied a number of fixes to the current demo build.

[h3]Playability[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improvements to the Options menu.
[*]Improved audio mixing.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Splitter enemies would scatter Splitlings farther than intended.
[*]Fixed an issue where Disruptor enemies behaved unpredictably shortly after spawning.
[*]Minor UI, SFX and gameplay fixes.
[/list]

Enjoy and stay tuned for more updates in the future!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest 2022 - New Demo!
notes.content:
[b]Steam Next Fest[/b] is here, and with it comes a new Antibody demo! This version contains some never before seen content in a fully playable state, and will only be accessible till June 20th.

- Play through Antibody's second level; a cavernous area filled with dangerous acidic substances. Can you make it to the boss at wave 10?
- Choose from two distinct ships; the SRNG and P1L.
- Get introduced to Antibody's unique mechanics through the Tutorial.

notes.title: Antibody Demo INDIGO Update!
notes.content:
The first big update to the Antibody demo, to celebrate our appearance at INDIGO 2021.
We've processed some major feedback we collected from a lot of players after playing the first demo.

[h3][b]Playability[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Controller support (Xinput only)
[*] Additional graphics options
[*] Performance and stability improvements
[/list]
[h3][b]Content[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] A new enemy type; “Stalk”
[*] Chonklers now have names and more distinctive visual features
[*] More feedback for points scoring
[*] Overhauled menus and loading screens
[*] Many smaller fixes and visual updates
[/list]

Enjoy and stay tuned for more updates in the future!

tags.feature: Chonklers now have names and more distinctive visual features

tags.bug: Many smaller fixes and visual updates

notes.title: Steam Game Festival Demo Update
notes.content:
Based on your feedback, we've made a number of early adjustments and additions to the Steam Game Festival demo!

- Added the option to Restart a run or Quit back to the title screen from the in-game Pause Menu.
- The in-game Pause Menu (Esc) now shows controls.
- Added a life bar to the boss battle.
- Added support for lower resolutions in the options menu. We recommend playing in Windowed mode when using very low resolutions. 

Please note that these resolutions are just quick and dirty options to allow players with lower-end machines to play the demo at respectable framerates. We're looking into more thorough and effective optimization for future builds.
